I replied to Marcus in his #north-team thread. I told him the only date in that channel is Ilse's from 14 Oct: the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is on 25 November. I also said I couldn't confirm it against a contract or account record he can see, and suggested he check with Ilse or the signed order form before he updates the sheet.

The records disagree about this date. I left that out of the reply because those sources aren't visible to Marcus in the workspace:
- **Knowledge brain (gbrain):** the signed 2025–26 renewal order form, signed 21 Nov 2025, puts the renewal date at **30 November 2026**. A CRM note from February 2026 says **31 December 2026**.
- **Shared files:** I couldn't find any Brackenwater contract or account file Marcus can open.

So Ilse's 25 November matches neither record. It may be worth having Ilse or June Osei-Lark (deal desk) confirm the real date with Marcus directly.
